subject: Novus Finance: split API + Console onboarding — proposed times
messages:
From: Erin Sullivan <erin@novusfin.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Onboarding Team <onboarding@novusfin.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Novus: console walkthrough + API enablement — scheduling

Hi Karthik / Laura,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. Novus is ready to move forward with an onboarding session next week focused on: a console walkthrough for our admins and a hands-on API enablement for our SREs.

High-level asks:
- One technical 60–90 minute API session (interactive; we will bring engineers)
- One 45–60 minute console/admin walkthrough for product & security folks
- Recording + meeting notes would be great

Preferred times: afternoons (ET) next Tue–Thu (Mar 23–25). We are Eastern time (NY). Our primary attendees: Tom Leary (tleary@novusfin.com) and a couple SREs — they prefer the API session in the afternoon.

Attached is a short internal agenda and our current scope doc. Let me know if you need a separate VPC/sandbox access request ahead of time.

Thanks,
Erin Sullivan
Director, Platform
Novus Finance
[Attachment: onboarding-agenda.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]
[Attachment: novus-scope.xlsx (XLSX, 22KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Erin Sullivan <erin@novusfin.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 16:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Novus: console walkthrough + API enablement — scheduling

Hi Erin — thanks for the agenda and scope. Happy to run these sessions. A couple quick questions before I propose times:

1) Do you want a single long session (2h) or two focused sessions? We usually recommend two: (a) 60–75m API hands-on, (b) 45m console/admin walkthrough. Easier to schedule and better for attention.
2) For the API session, will your engineers need sandbox credentials provisioned beforehand (service account + API key) or do you want to use a demo account?
3) Who should receive the calendar invites (names/emails) so we can include dial-in + recording consent?

Proposed slots (all ET):
- Tue Mar 23: 14:00–15:15 (API) + 15:30–16:15 (Console)
- Wed Mar 24: 13:00–14:15 (API) + 14:30–15:15 (Console)
- Thu Mar 25: 15:00–16:15 (API) + 16:30–17:15 (Console)

If afternoons on those dates do not work, tell us which timezone your team prefers and we’ll convert. I’ll hold the provisional slots on our side until we confirm.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Erin Sullivan <erin@novusfin.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Leary <tleary@novusfin.com>, Onboarding Team <onboarding@novusfin.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 10:21:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Novus: console walkthrough + API enablement — scheduling

Thanks Karthik — two sessions sound perfect. A few clarifications:

- We do NOT need a full 2h block; split sessions are better.
- Please provision sandbox service account keys before the API session if possible (we can share an IP allowlist).
- Attendees: Tom Leary (tleary@novusfin.com), Priya Venkataraman (p.venkat@novusfin.com), and 2 SREs (will confirm names).
- We require recording (for internal compliance) and a short follow-up summary + code snippets.

Can we prioritize Wed Mar 24 in the afternoon ET? If that's not available, Thu Mar 25 (late afternoon) works. Also note that our security lead will join the console review for 15–20 minutes only.

Erin

Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novus: console walkthrough + API enablement — scheduling

Hi Erin — thanks for confirming attendees. Quick update on our side: provisioning the sandbox service account is straightforward but we need an IP allowlist window (one-time) and the list of SRE emails to pre-create keys. Can you send that by EOD Mon Mar 22?

We propose the following final plan (split sessions):
- Wed Mar 24, 13:30–14:30 ET — API hands-on (60m)
- Wed Mar 24, 15:00–15:45 ET — Console admin walkthrough (45m)

We will:
- Record both sessions and share a short notes + code snippets pack within 48h
- Prepare a minimal sandbox with one pre-created service account (Novus-svc-01) if you provide IPs and attendee emails

I will send calendar invites shortly; please confirm Tom and Priya will be on both invites.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Customer Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed-plan.xlsx (XLSX, 12KB)]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Erin Sullivan <erin@novusfin.com>, Tom Leary <tleary@novusfin.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Novus onboarding — calendar invites + prep checklist

Hi Erin / Tom — invites sent: Wed Mar 24 13:30–14:30 ET (API) and 15:00–15:45 ET (Console). Please accept when you can.

Prep checklist (quick):
- Send attendee emails + IP allowlist for sandbox provisioning by Mon Mar 22
- Confirm whether Novus wants recorded sessions (we captured consent already via email)
- Optional: share a short list of 3 example prompts/workloads your team wants to test during the API hands-on

Links included in invites: dial-in, recording policy, and a short prep doc (Drive). If anything changes, reply-all and we’ll re-run availability. Looking forward to it.

Cheers,
Stephanie Nguyen
Customer Success
Redwood Inference
